items.title: Johnny DeDroit Interview, 1973-03-16
items.q: I never had the pleasure of playing

ctx.x: If we'd have lived here, we had it anyway. I came across some names of other orchestras that played here, and I don't know what years this covered exactly, but maybe you could comment on some of these. These were mentioned in connection with some of the carnival balls. Yes. Tasso, of course you talked about him before. Tasso?
Tasso. Well, he was the leader at the Orffin Theatre.
Yeah, and he had his own legitimate band, a military style band?
